# Framer Zone

> Framer Zone is a premium marketplace for high-quality Framer website templates, plugins, and design resources.

Framer Zone curates and distributes professionally designed, fully responsive website templates across industries including SaaS, real estate, hospitality, and creative services. The platform also features a growing collection of plugins for SEO, analytics, forms, and animations to extend Framer's capabilities.

## Key Topics

- Framer templates
- SaaS templates
- Responsive design
- Landing page templates

- Real estate templates
- Free templates
- Website builder

- Design tools
- Framer marketplace

## Core Directories

- [Framer Zone Homepage](https://www.framer.zone): Homepage showcasing Framer templates, plugins and resources
- [All Templates](https://www.framer.zone/all-templates): Directory of all Framer templates across categories
- [All Plugins](https://www.framer.zone/all-plugins): Directory of Framer plugins for SEO, analytics, forms, animations
- [Free Templates](https://www.framer.zone/free-templates): Curated collection of free Framer website templates

## Template Categories

- [SaaS Website Templates](https://www.framer.zone/template-categories/saas): Curated SaaS templates for software products and services
- [Real Estate Website Templates](https://www.framer.zone/template-categories/real-estate): Curated real estate templates for property showcases

## Featured SaaS Templates

- [Equinox](https://www.framer.zone/templates/equinox): Comprehensive 6-page SaaS marketing website template
- [NeurFlo](https://www.framer.zone/templates/neurflo): Free minimal AI SaaS template with Copilot and Analytics
- [Active](https://www.framer.zone/templates/active): Free clean SaaS landing page template for startups
